 HoopsHype Nov. 13, 2026, 7:03 p.m. ET Guard Quentin Grimes, who sprained the right pinkie on his shooting hand and missed the Lakers' past two games, participated in the live portion of practice Friday, Redick said. Grimes said he jammed the finger in the Pistons game and taped it up for practice. "The swelling has gone down a lot," Grimes said. "It's kind of feeling basically back to normal."
